youtube_short.title: Name Brands Steal $2,100/Year From You
title_alternatives: Store Brand vs Name Brand — The $2,100 Truth
Why I Stopped Buying Name Brands (It's Wild)
youtube_short.description: 80% of store-brand grocery products come from the exact same factory as the name brand. Same ingredients, same production line — just a different label. Yet the average household pays $2,100 more per year for that label. If you invested the difference at 8% returns instead, after 30 years you'd have $237,000. Start with the easy swaps: canned goods, pasta, cleaning supplies, frozen veggies, and cereal. You won't notice the difference. Your bank account will. #moneytips #savemoney #personalfinance #groceryhacks #finance
